This file is a patch file correcting a Perl operator precedence issue in kernel documentation scripts. The issue: in Perl 5.41+, the code `if (!$param =~ /\w\.\.\.$/)` triggers a warning because `!` has higher precedence than `=~`, meaning `!$param` is evaluated first (converting the string to boolean) rather than the intended `(!($param =~ /\w\.\.\.$/))`. The patch fixes this by adding parentheses to ensure correct precedence. This is a legitimate bug fix from a legitimate kernel developer (Peter Maydell, Linaro) addressing a language-specific issue in documentation tooling.
